title.name: Salinas de Oro
title.subtitle: A summer at the inland salt pans
menu.normal.note: A real summer: ten days to make as much salt as you can.
intro.1: In Salinas de Oro a spring of very salty water rises from the ground. Salt is thought to have been made from it for centuries.
intro.2: The water runs down wooden channels to the eras, shallow beds where the sun evaporates it and leaves the salt behind.
intro.3: It's summer. You have ten days to fill the beds, rake the white salt and carry it to the store. Watch out for storms!
howto.title: How to play
howto.b: [B] open or close a bed's sluice: close it when it's full
howto.sun: The sun dries the water and the salt appears
howto.a: Hold [A] to rake it while it's white. Wait too long and it greys and is worth less
howto.carry: [A] to load the salt into your basket, and [A] at the store to leave it. It's sold at nightfall
howto.storm: If clouds come, rake fast! Rain dissolves the salt
evening.title: Nightfall at the salt pans

gl.title: Salt worker's word
gl.manantial.name: Spring (manantial)
gl.manantial.text: Water rising from the ground. Here it's very salty.
gl.era.name: Era (salt bed)
gl.era.text: A shallow bed where the sun evaporates the salty water.
gl.compuerta.name: Sluice (compuerta)
gl.compuerta.text: The little board that lets water into each bed, or shuts it off.
gl.rasero.name: Rake (rasero)
gl.rasero.text: A wooden tool for gathering the salt into heaps.
gl.salmuera.name: Brine (salmuera)
gl.salmuera.text: Water with a lot of salt dissolved in it, like the spring's.
fact.centuries: Salt is thought to have been made at Salinas de Oro for centuries, from its salty spring.
fact.saltier: The spring water is much saltier than seawater.
fact.preserve: Before fridges, salt was used to preserve food like meat, fish and cheese.
fact.salary: It's often said the word "salary" comes from salt, because it was so valuable.
fact.anana: Nearby, in Álava, are the Añana salt pans, also inland and spring-fed.
fact.sun: The water in the beds isn't boiled: the sun and wind evaporate it bit by bit.
fact.summer: Salt is made mostly in summer, when the sun is strongest.
call.cart: A muleteer's here! He wants {kg} kg: take it to the store
call.cartGone: The muleteer got tired of waiting
call.goat: Goats in the beds! Run at them
howto.flor: Just dried, the salt glows gold: that's flor de sal, worth double. Rake white salt in a row to build your streak
howto.extra: Muleteers come with orders (fill them fast) and goats trample the salt: run at them
gl.flor.name: Flor de sal
gl.flor.text: The finest layer of salt, which crystallises on top. It's considered the finest and most valuable.
gl.arriero.name: Arriero (muleteer)
gl.arriero.text: Someone who carried goods with mules. Salt is said to have travelled from village to village this way.
gl.cabra.name: Goats
gl.cabra.text: Goats love licking salt… and trampling it!
